interpretation: Direct requests bypass window conditions and measure potential only.
Conditional and scripted policies use engine-truth geometry/window observations; no human success rate is measured.
Off is the same input policy with the secret connection disabled, not a pure damage multiplier comparison.
No runtime files, configuration constants, wounds, hit tests, uses, or stamina thresholds are changed.
All timelines are fixed-step physics converted to standard seconds by TIME.k; camera, hit stop, secret slow motion and rendering are absent.
Ranges specify initial direct-request distance or a target for normal input; actual request distance is recorded separately.
Severity is onWound reported trauma; lacerationSeverity is the actual new wound list. End-point and peak consciousness loss are separate.
